## 🎓 Today's lesson
- **What is a "Sovereign Wealth Fund"?** A sovereign wealth fund is a state-owned investment fund composed of money generated by the government, often derived from natural resource revenues, trade surpluses, or budget savings. Governments use these funds to invest globally in stocks, bonds, and infrastructure to diversify their economies and secure long-term financial returns for future generations—similar to Canada's newly launched fund managed by former Bridgewater executives [[CBC]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxPYmV3OHlVQ1NPdlQydHJVNDJ2cFdQcGZvRUxYTmdfMlNCMkdUdUp4Uzl5ejFnRjdtZnZGbGl6bWVuNlBUU28tUDFJUFJTNDFBTTFCZmxPVUVXLVdYY1NrcENRZzNDT2VKN1BfWDk4LUwwRDVfaDg5Vi1uOGZJX01LZnFxRDEtNmFJYVhoMUl5RQ?oc=5) [[BNN Bloomberg]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNcFQ1VU5tbGFSUUVZeVJfd1paODlHc2JvZmN2dndyUTdBdGZrU04yS0k0VG1UaEx3eF94TlJlYnVFNFR4VWVrTVdja2FEMjl4MUQ4LVdGNVN5Zm15RTkwYXdxaUk5ekd2elRZVGUtYTVHdEw1ampoNkFIVmV2bGtxeHEtX0VSSVhBVEFzQVRYVTJGMUZNYzBWRFZCLXQ5dzRrV2RWekxHeE1taVBsUGxEYTlxOA?oc=5).
